name: AutomationDirect ZP-MC06B-2-SSE16M connector hood
summary: ZP-MC06B-2-SSE16M connector hood arrangement: mounting, interface and service-space coordination.
description: ZP-MC06B-2-SSE16M is the drawing identifier for connector hood in AutomationDirect's ZIPport Multi-Wire Connectors collection. A connector hood forms the cable-side body of the selected connector assembly. The cable-entry direction and the room needed to mate and release the assembly are part of the layout.

For example, in a machine cable that disconnects from a panel-mounted connector, use the ZP-MC06B-2-SSE16M reference to coordinate cable entry, mating approach and locking access. Show the neighbouring equipment and the connection route so the installer can understand the intended arrangement.

Use the reviewed native drawing identified as Enclosures and Wiring/ZIPport Multi-Wire Connectors/ZP-MC06B-2-SSE16M.dwg for the exact physical details. Locate the named file in its original manufacturer archive. Manufacturer drawing previews are shown only when an exact approved source is available. Any illustrative 3D view is a separate concept and is not to scale; use the selected manufacturer documents for dimensions, ratings and installation details.
readingNotes: Keep cable entry, mating approach and locking access visible in the layout.
